content.text: Aer cannot directly execute the custom diffuser gate `U$_s$`. I’ll transpile the circuit for the backend before running it, preserving the computation while converting the gate into supported instructions.

output.arguments: {"command":"$PY -c \"from pathlib import Path; p = Path('buggy.py'); s = p.read_text(); s = s.replace('from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, QuantumRegister, Aer', 'from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, QuantumRegister, Aer, transpile'); s = s.replace('# Missing transpile step causes \\\"Circuit contains invalid instructions\\\" error\\njob = backend.run(circuit)', '# Compile the custom diffuser gate into backend-supported instructions.\\ncircuit = transpile(circuit, backend)\\njob = backend.run(circuit)'); p.write_text(s)\"; $PY buggy.py"}
